entries.title: Creature bodies skip the bloom pulse's Newton solve when openness is 0
entries.inUse: Creature bodies under SpindleLodSystem (SpindleDepthGraph), ~50 per Garland/Lattice match
entries.waste: ~9 sin/cos and 13 divides per body pixel multiplied by an exact 0 for bodies nearer than ~313 u or farther than ~700 u
entries.change: insert `[branch] if (!(openness > 0.0)) return 0.0;` after openness, nothing moved
entries.probes: probe_reach: return 1 always; probe_guard: return 1 when openness <= 0. The 2026-11-12 material bench never reached openness 0: set _WorldSpaceCameraPos explicitly and place the body 150 u from the eye (shaders_pass2.md SG-1)
entries.otherStates: a body at 450 u (open band): identical and not slower

entries.title: Switch/race-gate rings compute the Voronoi lace only when its weight is above 0
entries.runtimeWriters: lace = IncorporealDepth_Openness(v.metric, _IncorporealSpread) when Overt; rings from ToyFactory.WireRingMaterial (girth 0.076, _Distance 2e8)
entries.inUse: Every gate race, Regatta, Serpent Time, Tandava, Menu_Main mode preview
entries.waste: 3x3 Voronoi + fresnel^4 + pow per ring pixel multiplied by 0 for rings nearer than ~184 u or farther than ~700 u
entries.change: move the lace into the custom function behind `[branch] if (lace > 0.0)` (graph surgery: one Custom Function rewired)
entries.probes: probe_reach and probe_guard on the lace term
entries.negativeControl: gate on lace > 0.5 (must differ at 300-500 u)
entries.gain: 2-3x per ring pixel; rings are thin

entries.title: PrismPaperBurn skips the ember flicker noise outside the char band
entries.runtimeWriters: PrismBurnFxConfigSO (Resources/PrismBurnFxConfig.asset) holds PrismPaperBurnNear/Mid.mat; the burn stamp per prism
entries.waste: one valueNoise (8 hashes) per burning-paper pixel outside the char band, where the ember term is exactly 0
entries.change: wrap the flicker/ember block in `if (charT > 0.0 && burn.x >= 0.001)`
entries.probes: needs a fixed _Burn stamp in spec.floats so the char band exists in the bench
entries.negativeControl: branch on rim > 0 only (drops the char glow; must differ)
entries.gain: ~30 % of the burn fragment while burning; ~0 of most frames

entries.title: CapsuleMembrane draws only the capsules the camera can see
entries.runtimeWriters: subdivisions 4 (2,562 capsules) on Desktop/MobileHigh (PlatformProfile membraneMaxSubdivisions -1); renderParams.camera never set; matrices at 20 Hz
entries.inUse: 104 cell configs incl. Garland (the menu world) and Skim Race
entries.waste: 63-87 % of 2,562 capsules vertex-shaded and clipped every frame from inside the sphere
entries.change: order-preserving per-camera sphere-frustum cull before RenderMeshInstanced, behind a static toggle the scene bench can flip
entries.negativeControl: cull radius 0 (centre-point test): edge capsules vanish
entries.otherStates: every camera that renders the cell (mode preview, hangar stage): per-camera submission
entries.gain: 1.5-1.85 M fewer triangles per frame at the menu; 0.1-0.3 ms on an RTX 3080, more on a phone

entries.title: Vessel jets stop simulating their invisible root particle system
entries.runtimeWriters: No script touches jet particle systems; the root PS (fileID 2513661457047019541) loops at rate 10 with its renderer disabled; no overrides
entries.inUse: Every vessel jet on every machine (VesselJet.prefab): ~16-24 root systems in a 4-seat match
entries.waste: a particle system that spawns and ages ~10 particles nobody can ever see
entries.change: root EmissionModule.enabled = 0 (keep the component so Play/Stop cascade)
entries.probes: FIRST log root.particleCount for 60 frames in Play: if it never changes, reject (already free). The scene bench toggles Behaviours; a ParticleSystem emission toggle needs a small bench extension
entries.negativeControl: disable emission on the Particles child instead (sparkles vanish)
entries.gain: 20-100 us per match frame, if the system is not already culled
